items.title: What is a dirty bomb and how dangerous is the weapon
items.summary: President Trump warned Iran against orchestrating a "dirty bomb" attack in Washington, D.C., though the White House says there are no credible threats. The big picture: Unlike a nuclear weapon, a "dirty bomb" uses common explosives to scatter radioactive material, potentially contaminating surrounding areas, forcing evacuations and causing widespread disruption. items.title: Trump warns Iran over allegations of dirty bomb threat to Washington
items.summary: Iran denied media reports based on US intelligence that it may be planning a dirty bomb attack in the US capital, with questions swirling about its actual intentions or real capabilities for such an act, but Trump issued a strong warning against Tehran "because they happen to be crazy."

items.title: Iran planning ‘dirty bomb’, chemical weapon attack on Trump officials in Washington, warns US intelligence: Report
items.summary: US intelligence has reportedly identified detailed Iranian plans for potential attacks on US soil, including the use of unconventional weapons. CNN says the plotting is not considered evidence of an imminent attack, and sources say it is unclear whether Iran has operatives in place.

items.title: Nvidia rules out Jensen Huang comeback despite backing from big names
items.summary: Nvidia is not considering reinstating the scandal-hit Jensen Huang as chief executive, despite a growing campaign for his return.

items.title: Nvidia rules out Jensen Huang comeback as campaign for his return grows
items.summary: The “Stand With Jensen” campaign listed SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney among its signatories.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies
items.summary: Jensen Huang is considering ​a comeback as Nvidia's CEO, and ‌has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar ​with the matter.

items.title: Nvidia delivers strong results as investors weigh post-Huang future​
items.summary: With Huang gone, investors are looking for clues about Nvidia’s future.

items.title: Nvidia delivers strong results to investors, shares rise nearly ​4% in extended trading
US strikes targets in Qeshm Island after Iranian mines hit five ships in Hormuz
items.summary: Iran says the US military carried out several attacks on Qeshm Island in southern Iran, while at least five ships were set on fire by mines in the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the day.

items.title: U.S. allies on edge as Trump heads to summit with Xi and Putin
items.summary: President Trump's trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin has the makings of an unpredictable spectacle — and that's exactly what has U.S. allies anxious. items.summary: An Indian seafarer is missing and two others have been hospitalized after the Panama-flagged LPG tanker TARA GAS came under repeated attack in the Strait of Hormuz, forcing its 25-member...

items.title: LPG tanker attacked twice in Hormuz, seafarer missing
items.summary: An Indian government Minister says the Tara Gas was attacked a second time forcing the crew to abandon ship

items.title: Nvidia forms national security committee after Huang affair
items.summary: Nvidia has created a board-level committee for national security and export control. This follows the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang over extramarital affairs, allegedly including one with a Chinese intelligence asset.

items.title: Nvidia forms board committee to oversee national security, export controls
items.summary: The committee will oversee Nvidia’s national security and global trade compliance programs.

items.title: Guinea jails more than 220 people in deadly crackdown on illegal gold mining
items.summary: Guinea is stepping up its fight against illegal gold mining, with more than 220 people sentenced to prison in a major crackdown that is triggering violence and mass displacement.

items.title: Guinea jails 200 in wildcat gold mining crackdown
items.summary: A Conakry court has jailed 22 former local officials from the gold-rich northeastern Siguiri region, as well as 200 people accused of illegal mining. It's part of a wider crackdown that sent thousands fleeing into Mali.
